flag_rule: flag the 20% of contacts with the highest predicted probability
recalibrate: re-estimate the threshold on the most recent completed quarter; refit the model quarterly
validated_model_threshold_probability_no: 80th percentile of the validated model's predictions on its own training set; the 80th percentile of its test-set predictions (Supplementary Table S19) was 0.498. Either defines a 20% flag rate on the population it is computed on; set the live threshold from the most recent completed quarter.
